snippet.title: Selection Process trailer
snippet.description:
​Congratulations!
You are in the process of selecting the job of your dreams.
You will have to assert yourself between the different candidates and the different tests to be able to achieve that desired job.

Are you able to defeat the Human Resources?
Or are you going to give up now that you are close to getting that job you wanted?

Instructions:

W,A ,S, D - Move

Control - Crouch

​Space - Jump

​Tab - Slow down time

​Right Click - Change weapon firing mode -Burst mode: Hold down left click -Normal mode: Press left click

The objective is to defeat all the enemies, once done, the elevator will open and you can pass the level

I hope you enjoy this game as much or more as I did in making it.​

Selection Process in Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/1644030/Selection_Process/?beta=0
